## Mod Information

###### Mode: Summoners Rift & Aram

###### Author: Zelos & Leischii

###### Mod version: 6.0.1

###### Description: Enables Odyssey Kayn announcer on Summoners Rift & Aram.

 

## Installation

In order for the announcer to work you will have to install the "Base Mod" AND one of the language addons. If your announcer is mute, you didn't install a language addon.
